items.reply:
A seal-in keeps the motor running after Start is released.

| Input | State | Motor |
|---|---|---|
| Start pressed | Stop closed | runs |
| Start released | Stop closed | keeps running |
| Stop pressed | - | stops |

The holding contact is the motor's own auxiliary contact.
